title: Very nice golden yellow Pom Pom blanket.
text: Very nice golden yellow Pom Pom blanket.. Very nice golden yellow colored blanket.  It’s soft on both sides with the one side being really soft and the other side almost as soft as the really soft side.  I love the look of the Pom Poms and they are sewn onto the blanket very well.  I would buy it again.

product_metadata.title: BT.WA Couch Cover L Shape Sectional Sofa Cover 2-Piece Soft Stretch Reversible Sofa Slipcover 3 Seater + 3 Seater Furniture Protector Couch Slipcover with 2Pcs Pillowcases (Navy)
features: 【Size Tip】: 3 Seater + 3 Seater L-Shaped Couch Cover for Corner or L-Shaped Sofa. This item is made up of 2 pieces, Applicable Dimension - one piece for main sofa Length: 71" - 90"(180 cm - 230 cm) and another for chaise Length: 71 - 90 inches (180 - 230 cm), perfect for L-shaped sectional sofas. Following the information on the measuring guide, please measure your sofa before purchasing to ensure our sofa covers will match your sofa. Because the fabric is silky, it is NOT recommended for smooth leather furniture.

【High Quality Fabric】: Polyester 95% + Spandex 5%, soft touch and good elasticity, its elastic properties make it easier to stretch, so it is suitable for most modular sofas. And comfortable, skin-friendly and durable, non-pilling, non-fading, breathable fabric for year-round use.

【Furniture Protector】: This L-shaped sofa slipcover is stretchable, anti-wrinkle, anti-bite and easy to install. Protect your sofa from stains, baby poop, pet hair and damage. This couch slipcover not only protects your furniture, it refreshes your furniture and ensures it will last for many years. It's also great for families with kids and pets. Available in a variety of colors to suit any home style.

【Easy to Install】: Easy to install with Our User Manual. Our sofa covers come with foam sticks that can be inserted into the gaps in the sofa seat cushions to keep the sofa cover in place and look neat and beautiful. In addition, our sectional couch cover also has several ropes, which can be tied to the bottom of the sofa to fix the L shape couch cover to achieve a good anti-slip effect.

【Easy to Clean】: Hand Washable or Machine Washable, Gently Wash in Cold Water, Do Not Bleach, Do Not Iron, Hang to Dry. We not only provide quality couch covers, but also focus on providing good customer service. If you have any questions about installation, product dimensions or product quality issues, please contact us via our email or Buyer Message Center and we will be happy to assist you.
